timing: Recorded before inspecting any numerical held-out score tables; training progress logs only were read
primary_probe: linear ridge; nonlinear tanh32 probe is separate sensitivity, never chosen by test score
primary_family: self_supervised versus supervised, fraction1, dimensions4/8/16/32/64, each of10 observed properties:50 prespecified exploratory comparisons
effect: paired standardized squared error self_supervised minus supervised; negative favors self_supervised
intervals: 256 paired fire bootstrap replicates conditional on fitted models; region/year-region sensitivity where supported
p_values: Two-sided paired group sign-flip on known source-reported region aggregates, exact enumeration where feasible; exclude unknown region only from this sensitivity, retain all fires in primary estimates. Coarse groups and source labels limit inferential meaning.
adjustment: Holm across the50 prespecified property/dimension comparisons; exploratory model-comparison diagnostics only, no causal or global scientific superiority claim
training_randomness: single seed, not estimated by test-fire bootstrap
generalization: Per-year and reported-region results descriptive for the preserved random whole-fire split. True chronological/geographic retraining extensions must not be claimed from stratification alone.
